_provenance.generated_by: Synthetic LTEE fitness trajectories using published parameter estimates from Wiser 2013 Table S1
_provenance.data_origin: Synthetic data mimicking 12 LTEE population fitness trajectories; parameters derived from published power-law fits
_provenance.real_data_accession: N/A (synthetic from published parameters; real LTEE data at https://github.com/wiser/LTEE-fitness-data for future Tier 2)

_description: Reproduce Wiser et al. (2013) model selection analysis: fit power-law, hyperbolic, and logarithmic models to LTEE fitness trajectories, then rank by AIC/BIC. The power-law model should win (unbounded fitness increase), matching the paper's central result.
_groundspring_question: Do LTEE fitness trajectories follow a power law (unbounded adaptation) or approach an asymptote (diminishing returns)? The answer has implications for Anderson disorder models of fitness landscapes.
_cross_spring: lithoSpore module 1 (power-law fitness), hotSpring B2 (Anderson disorder analogy for fitness landscape)

_ltee_guidestone.blocks: Pillar 4 exit gate (2+ modules PASS at Tier 1)

model._description: Generate 12 synthetic LTEE population fitness trajectories using power-law parameters typical of published fits. Fit three competing models and select by AIC/BIC.

power_law_params._note: w(t) = (1 + alpha * t)^beta; approximate values from Wiser 2013 Table S1 population means
